signal: At complete session t close, previous market session and current session both have valid active quote, previous comparable close <=newL and current close >newL AND current close<newU; signal day non-ST; flat at close. Next market session open only, never fill t close. A failed next-session buy is cancelled; require a fresh cross. No same-day re-entry after an exit; new cross on later day can re-enter. Fixed boxes, no rolling refit.
entry: Attempt next session open, valid active non-ST quote. Executable buy price=ceil_to_cent(open*(1+0.0005)), capped at observed daily high as a daily-data cost approximation. Skip if opening quote<=lower or opening/effective buy>=upper, one-price limit-up, insufficient cash or size >1% previous session volume. 100-share lots; buy largest affordable lot. Current day high/low are only ex-post fill-quality/cost evidence, never features; daily data cannot prove auction liquidity.
stop: Initial stop=0.90*actual buy price; t+1 sellability. Gap open<=stop exits at open with adverse slippage, not at stop. Otherwise daily low<=stop triggers at stop with adverse slippage. If sell blocked by no quote/suspension/one-price lower-limit, pending stop stays live to next executable session; loss may exceed10%. Intraday stop/TP on entry day not executed because T+1; a breached stop on entry day is latched for next executable open.
take_profit: Sell at new upper edge when reached, only after buy day. If open>=target, conservatively fill at target limit price (no favorable gap windfall). Require high strictly greater than cent-ceiled target for intraday fill, not mere touch; stop wins if both touched intraday and order unknown. If open triggers target before later stop, target wins because opening precedes intraday. Upper limit sale has no additional adverse slippage (limit fill), transaction fees remain.
exit_cost: Market/stop exits=floor_to_cent(reference*(1-0.0005)), bounded below by observed low; on upper-edge limit exit use ceil_to_cent(target). One-price lower-limit sale never assumed filled. Price limits from preclose and historical mainboard10%/ST5%, rounded half-up tocent; one-price bars at that limit blocked only on adverse side. Unrecognized quote/reference regime => diagnostic exception, not fill proof.
